card.profile: Gangsta Walking, also known as G-Walk, Buckin', Tickin', Jookin', and Choppin', is an African American street dance that began among African-American communities in Memphis, Tennessee in the 1980s.
card.insight: It is said that this style was banned from the clubs shortly after being created due to the wildness it invoked in performers as well as onlookers.
